// shared/types/export.ts
import { RegisterSchema, LoginSchema } from '@modules/auth/auth.schema'
import { PropertySchema } from '@modules/properties/properties.schema'
import fs from 'fs'

// Используем zod-to-ts или просто реэкспортируем z.infer<>
const types = `
// AUTO-GENERATED — не редактировать вручную

export type { RegisterInput, LoginInput } from '../modules/auth/auth.schema'
export type { CreatePropertyInput } from '../modules/properties/properties.schema'
`

fs.writeFileSync('../frontend/src/types/api.ts', types)
console.log('Types exported to frontend')

npm install @fastify/swagger @fastify/swagger-ui

# Fastify автоматически генерирует OpenAPI из Zod схем
# Затем orval или openapi-typescript генерирует типы для фронта:
npx openapi-typescript http://localhost:3000/docs/json -o src/types/api.ts

// app/plugins.ts
import swagger from '@fastify/swagger'
import swaggerUI from '@fastify/swagger-ui'
import jwt from '@fastify/jwt'
import cookie from '@fastify/cookie'
import cors from '@fastify/cors'

export async function registerPlugins(app: FastifyInstance) {
  await app.register(cors, { origin: process.env.FRONTEND_URL, credentials: true })
  await app.register(cookie)
  await app.register(jwt, { secret: process.env.JWT_SECRET! })

  await app.register(swagger, {
    openapi: {
      info: { title: 'Rental API', version: '1.0.0' }
    }
  })
  await app.register(swaggerUI, { routePrefix: '/docs' })
}

FROM node:20-alpine AS base
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./

FROM base AS deps
RUN npm ci --only=production

FROM base AS builder
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npx prisma generate
RUN npm run build

FROM base AS runner
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=builder /app/prisma ./prisma
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["sh", "-c", "npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/server.js"]

version: '3.9'
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: always
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: pass
      POSTGRES_DB: rental
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - '5432:5432'

  backend:
    build: .
    restart: always
    depends_on:
      - postgres
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://user:pass@postgres:5432/rental
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET}
      PORT: 3000
    ports:
      - '3000:3000'

volumes:
  pg_data:

  # Только postgres в Docker, бэкенд локально (быстрее для разработки)
  docker compose up postgres -d

  # Применить миграции
  npm run db:migrate

  # Запустить бэкенд с hot reload
  npm run dev
